name: Boku no Kawaii Oningyou
source:
The dollmaker Tsumugi Shidou devoted his daily efforts to creating the perfect doll. All the while living a happy life with his doll, Amelia.

Tsumugi dotes on Amelia.
Amelia swears loyalty to Tsumugi.
They thought their relationship would last forever. 

[Translated from [url=https://daitaijaguchi.wixsite.com/index/blank-1]official website[/url]]
translation:
人偶师糸堂紬每天致力于制作完美人偶，同时与自己的玩偶阿梅莉娅过着幸福生活。紬宠爱阿梅莉娅，阿梅莉娅则发誓效忠紬。他们以为这段关系会永远持续。

[译自[url=https://daitaijaguchi.wixsite.com/index/blank-1]官方网站[/url]]
